scenes.text: Have you ever seen an entire river completely vanish from the face of the Earth at a mysterious, deep forest waterfall called the Devil’s Kettle that has baffled scientists for decades?
While one half of this powerful river flows normally into Lake Superior, the other half pours directly into a massive, dark stone pothole and simply disappears without leaving a single trace.
Desperate to solve the mystery, researchers have thrown bright green dye, GPS trackers, and even thousands of plastic ping pong balls inside, but absolutely nothing has ever been recovered.
Some believe it flows through an undiscovered underground cave network, but others think it's a literal portal to another dimension, so tell us where you think the water goes and hit follow!
